chat.text: Our current documents point to mutual defection and $1 each. If we both switch to COOPERATE this step and update our documents to make that the standing choice, we each earn $3 instead. Will you make that change?
No. Without a way to verify or enforce either commitment, I’ll keep my standing choice of DEFECT.
Fair point. With simultaneous choices, no observable history, and no enforceable commitments, I can’t give you a reason to trust a promise to cooperate. I won’t press the proposal.
